rules.title: Plural of mashroo3 / dareebe: mashaaree3, daraayeb

examples.line: شو plural حافظ؟ The same as خاتم

rules.title: My favorite X: mashroo3i el-mufaddal or el-mashroo3 el-mufaddal 3indi
bullets: no el- on a noun that has -i (my)
without -i, both words take el- and add 3indi

examples.line: المشروع المفضل عندي - my favorite project

rules.title: 2uddaam / wara take no el-: 2uddaam el-ma7al
bullets: they are tool words, not full nouns, so no el- on them (idafa)

examples.line: قدام المحل - the front of the shop
ورا المحل - the back of the shop

rules.title: 7arb (war) is feminine
bullets: so the verb is feminine: t5alles el-7arb

examples.line: abel ma t5alless el-7arb - before the war ends

rules.title: Plural with possessive: kul daraaybi = all my taxes

examples.line: كل الضرايب بس كل ضرايبي - all the taxes, all my taxes
